chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from the one who narrated to him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Wuheyb ibn Hafs, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, when Al-Qa'im (peace be upon him) arises, he will return the Sacred House to its foundation, and the Mosque of the Messenger to its foundation, and the Mosque of Kufa to its foundation.
And Abu Baseer said: 'To the place of the date-sellers from the Mosque.'

key_terms.مَسْجِدَ الرَّسُولِ: The Mosque of the Messenger (Prophet's Mosque in Medina)

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam Al-Qa'im do with the holy mosques upon his rise?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights the eschatological restoration of Islamic sanctity by Al-Qa'im, who rebuilds the Kaaba, the Prophet's Mosque, and the Mosque of Kufa to their primordial foundations, symbolizing the purification of religious practice from historical accretions. Abu Baseer’s specific addition regarding the 'date-sellers' (Al-Tammarin) in Kufa provides crucial historical context, linking the mosque's boundaries to the early community's economic and social life, thereby emphasizing the Imam's role in restoring both spiritual and communal integrity. This act reflects the Shia belief in the return to the pure, uncorrupted Sunnah and the establishment of divine justice in the heart of the Islamic world.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from the one who narrated it, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Wuheyb Bin Hafs, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>, when he<sup>asws</sup> arises, would return the Sacred House back to its foundations, and the Masjid of the Rasool<sup>saww</sup> back to its foundations, and Masjid Al-Kufa back to its foundations’.
And Abu Baseer said, ‘To the place of the date-sellers from the Masjid’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from those who he has mentioned from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Wuhayb ibn Hafs from abu Basir who has said the following:

“When al-Qa’im will rise with Divine Authority, he will return the House to its foundation, the Masjid of the messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, to its foundation and the Masjid of al-Kufa to its foundation.”
Abu Basir has said, ‘Up to the place of the sellers of dates is of the area of the Masjid.’”
